tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[Integral curves in the square] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0465 1. apph:H.44\group Integral curves For $C=[-1,1]^2$ and $f=d(\cdot ,\partial C)$, the maximal normalized-gradient integral curve from a point runs linearly toward the central ridge, and thereafter along that ridge to the maximum set, with $f$ itself as parameter. \end{example}
